notes:
- Harbor Pro: activate a key and every feature turns on straight away, even in an open session.
- Overview has a chart suited to each metric, with a disk ring that warns when it's filling up.
- Insights groups similar errors and opens the full message and call stack right there.
- Logs can scroll back through older lines from your server.
- Open logs from Insights goes to the moment the error happened.
- Share a log line straight to Slack, or copy it when Slack isn't connected.
- The MCP page is easier to use, and its prompts can be copied.
- Search fields have a clear button.
- Harbor now updates itself.
